name: a thousand words that i could tell you
source:
After finding a mysterious necklace that allows her to travel back in time, a girl decides to use it to fix her troubled past.

[From [url=https://alyastastic.itch.io/a-thousand-words-that-i-could-tell-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩找到了一条可以让她回到过去的神秘项链后，决定用它来解决她麻烦不断的过去。

[来自[url=https://alyastastic.itch.io/a-thousand-words-that-i-could-tell-you]Itch.io[/url]]
